Cra-yon.context: Young Air is noted to have smoke and a hint of tobacco, which are not listed in the official notes.

Maison Matine.context: Shifumi smells amazing but has disappointing longevity and projection, staying very close to the skin.

BDK Parfums.context: Stellar Silk was called the best vanilla scent ever, described as smooth, addictive but not overly sweet.

Imaginary Authors.context: How To Say Bicycle In French was described as smelling like burned sage in a laundry room, a strange but not unpleasant combination.

Parfums Dusita.context: Multiple Parfums Dusita fragrances including Montri, Issara, and La series were listed as long-time favorites in the context of a 10th anniversary giveaway.

Fugazzi.context: MATCHABUYA created by perfumer Julien Rasquinet generated enthusiasm with a user asking for its re-release.

Chabaud Maison de Parfum.context: Caprice de Sophie was the subject of an article described as lovely by a commenter.

\u0101nti-Perfumery.context: Bast and Nashi Toro received good reviews and takes, prompting interest in purchasing a discovery set.

Goldfield & Banks.context: Sunset Hour Dark Peach was mentioned in the context of a discussion about underused cognac notes in fragrances.

Etat Libre D'Orange.context: Uruk Chronicles: Strawberry Shampoo & Baklava prompted a humorous comment about expecting a Lord of the Rings-based fragrance.

ABEL.context: Multiple Abel perfumes were praised, with Abel Pause described as a lovely gateway fragrance and the full current lineup owned in varying sizes.

Scents of Man.context: Yuzu Doré was recently purchased and absolutely loved, with the fruity and base notes working well together.

Arabiyat.context: Arabiyat Sugar's Cotton Blush and Lemon Sorbet was noted for a distinctive touch of coldness among lemon gourmands.

Abel.context: Reviewer collects all current Abel perfumes, with Abel Pause described as a gateway drug and praised as lovely.
